message.content:
This magazine cover features a white background with a red vertical border on the left. At the top, text reads "PERANG DINASTI PILKADA SERENTAK" and "MACETNYA PERKARA KORUPSI KEMENPORA." Below, the word "TEMPO" appears in large grey serif letters above "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU." The center contains the text "OUTLOOK EKONOMI 2021," "SAATNYA BERUBAH," and "Pandemi Covid-19 seharusnya jadi momentum mendorong ekonomi hijau. Sektor bisnis mana yang paling siap?"

The main illustration shows six figures in a horizontal line, progressing from left to right. The first three are dark-furred primates transitioning from a knuckle-walking posture to an upright stance. The fourth is a bearded man in a red cap, plaid shirt, and grey overalls, carrying a red-headed axe. The fifth is a stout man in a dark red suit and tan hard hat, smoking a cigar with wisps of smoke. The final figure, wearing a white shirt and glasses, bends over to water a small green sprout with a black watering can. The bottom displays a QR code, a barcode with "9 770126 427302," and details including "7-13 DESEMBER 2020" and "RP 45.000."
